note: The decree of 2025-02-28 on identity documents issued by the police's head (national identity card, residence and refugee cards): online pre-enrolment, enrolment at an identification post, issue within 48 hours. It requires a police-issued attestation for a lost or stolen card and a criminal record extract, naming no system for either. A law, and on identity documents: states nothing about station records. The held text is an excerpt, articles 2 to 31.
